formattedAddress: No. 372號, Section 1, Neihu Rd, Gangqian Village, Neihu District, Taipei City, Taiwan 114

text.text: DON'T order the squid!!! 🦑 I never give bad reviews but I was truly insulted by the quality of food and service here. I ordered the squid lunch set. Upon first bite, I tasted a weird flavor. I thought maybe I just wasn't familiar with the sauce. After the third bite, I could not handle the taste anymore and spit it out. I asked the server what kind of sauce they use and they said just a sauce for the grilled squid. They seemed annoyed that I even asked. Then they took it to the kitchen to "taste" and said there was nothing wrong. I asked if they tried it and they seemed irritated that they had to repeat themselves. They tried to gaslight me by saying nobody else had a problem with this dish, but when I walked around the restaurant to go to the bathroom, I saw that nobody else ordered it so of course nobody else had a problem. I asked the other guests at my table to smell the squid and they all stated that there was a strong stinky smell protruding from the squid. Clearly spoiled. Even the "spine" in the squid shrunk beyond recognition, a sign of being frozen for too long. The squid had a nasty taste and smell. Nobody else dared to try it. They offered me another main meal and I chose the chicken, which is $40 less than the squid. However, they charged me for the squid meal that I barely ate and said the chicken was "on the house." So I paid $300 for a $260 meal plus a stomachache. Not to mention the 10% service fee. It would have been a different story if they took responsibility for their spoiled food, but they didn't and instead gaslighted me. I'm not a chef but I know when food has gone bad, especially seafood. To serve that to customers without remorse is unforgiveable. I will not be returning here again.

text.text: They let you sit and talk as long as you want and this is why we come here often.  The food is actually pretty good as well. I’ve tried many different dishes and they are not superb but they are not too bad.   The vibe is chill and they don’t rush you so this is a good place to chat and relax with good friends.
